summary: Maria Santos (CSM) and Kevin O'Brien met with Alicia Monroe and Gregory Fisk of Summit Trust a week before their vendor committee, which is currently leaning toward VaultEdge for identity and possibly monitoring. Alicia cited late notification of the March Detect outage, post-outage alert delays and unresolved MFA enforcement gaps, while Gregory raised slow support responses. Kevin reported median alert latency down to ~40 seconds after the April tenant rebalance and an MFA enforcement fix shipped in Identity 3.6, though SSO session timeouts remain open until June with a proxy-side workaround. Facing a VaultEdge quote ~18% lower, Maria offered a one-year flat-price renewal with a March service credit, Comply v2 free for twelve months, and a named Identity support engineer with a four-hour P2 response. Alicia declined to commit, asking for evidence this week: the MFA fix live and the support commitment demonstrated.
